note: Curated, General-Note-anchored eligibility requirements per preference program. Shown as the missing facts behind a SUGGESTED opportunity on top of the base-NTR/MFN default; SAIL never self-validates a claim. `_default_fta` is the fallback for FTAs without an explicit entry.

requirements.label: Good is USMCA-originating
requirements.detail: Qualifies under the GN 11 / USMCA Annex 4-B rules of origin (tariff shift and/or regional value content; autos have additional LVC/steel-aluminum rules).

requirements.label: Valid USMCA certification of origin
requirements.detail: A certification with the nine minimum data elements (importer, exporter, or producer may certify). Importer must possess it at the time of the claim.

requirements.label: Shipped without third-country processing
requirements.detail: Transported to the U.S. without entering the commerce of a non-USMCA country (transshipment voids the claim).

USMCA.claim_note: Importer makes the claim and must be able to substantiate origin on CBP request; penalties apply to unsupported claims.

requirements.label: Good is originating under KORUS
requirements.detail: Meets the GN 33 rules of origin (wholly obtained, tariff shift, or regional value content per the product-specific rule).

requirements.label: Importer holds a KORUS certification of origin
requirements.detail: No prescribed form, but the certification/supporting information must be in the importer's possession when the claim is made.

requirements.label: Imported directly from Korea
requirements.detail: Not entered into the commerce of a third country in transit.

KORUS.claim_note: Filer asserts the claim; documentation required and verifiable by CBP.

GSP.status_note: GSP authority lapsed 2020-12-31 and has not been reauthorized; a claim cannot be made for current entries unless/until Congress renews it (retroactive refunds have historically followed renewal).

requirements.label: Country is a designated GSP beneficiary
requirements.detail: Listed in GN 4(a); A* excludes specified countries for the heading; A+ is least-developed beneficiaries only.

requirements.label: 35% value-content rule met
requirements.detail: Cost/value of materials produced in the beneficiary country plus direct processing costs >= 35% of appraised value.

requirements.label: Article is GSP-eligible (not excluded)
requirements.detail: The HTS line shows A/A*/A+ in the Special subcolumn and the product is not a statutory GSP exclusion.

requirements.label: Imported directly from the beneficiary country

GSP.claim_note: Lapsed program — shown for completeness; not currently claimable.

requirements.label: Country is a designated AGOA beneficiary sub-Saharan country
requirements.detail: Listed in GN 16(a); designations change by presidential proclamation.

requirements.label: 35% value-content rule met
requirements.detail: Includes the GN 16 cumulation and U.S.-content allowances.

requirements.label: Article is AGOA-eligible (symbol D on the line)
Imported directly into the U.S. customs territory

AGOA.claim_note: Apparel/textile claims have additional visa/certification requirements under GN 16.

requirements.label: Country is a designated CBI/CBERA beneficiary
requirements.detail: Listed in GN 7(a); E* excludes specified countries for the heading.

requirements.label: 35% value-content rule met
requirements.detail: Beneficiary-country (and qualifying U.S./PR) content >= 35% of appraised value.

requirements.label: Article is CBI-eligible (symbol E/E* on the line)
Imported directly from a beneficiary country

_default_fta.cfr: the program's implementing regulations (19 CFR Part 10)

requirements.label: Good is originating under the agreement's rules of origin
requirements.detail: Meets the product-specific rule (wholly obtained, tariff shift, or value content) in the agreement's General Note.

requirements.label: Valid claim / certification of origin
requirements.detail: Importer possesses the certification or supporting information required by the agreement.

requirements.label: Imported directly from the partner country

_default_fta.claim_note: Filer asserts the claim; origin must be substantiable on CBP request.
